selection.description: Four-record, legally redistributable OpenNGC excerpt for deterministic local development and tests.
selection.selectionRule: Named objects chosen to cover galaxy, nebula/cluster, supernova-remnant, and globular-cluster classifications.

source.citation: Mattia Verga and OpenNGC contributors, OpenNGC v20231203.
source.attribution: Contains data from OpenNGC, copyright OpenNGC contributors, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
source.coordinateSystem: Equatorial J2000 coordinates, sexagesimal in the source.
knownLimitations: This is a four-record excerpt and must not be described as the complete OpenNGC catalogue.
OpenNGC combines several upstream catalogues; its Sources column should be consulted for field-level origins.
The source identifies positions as J2000 but does not state a precise reference frame; the pipeline maps them to an operational ICRS J2000 frame only at the published source precision.
No uncertainty columns are present for the selected coordinates or magnitudes, so uncertainty is unavailable rather than assumed zero.
Redshift is heliocentric in OpenNGC and is preserved without converting it to distance.
